admission_policy.scope_statement: Exact8 by canonical-five source-bound non-geometry data-use admission candidate; distinct from effectiveness and consumption.

formal_population.scope_exclusion_statement: Only the approved 4I3U Exact8 is admitted by this candidate; 4I3V, 4I3W/G3H, all other same-group members, and heldout events remain outside scope.

use_policy.base_diffusion_inputs_boundary: Permission is limited to the validated base inputs; it does not approve every diffusion target, loss, scientific semantic, or execution.

prohibited_use_definitions.boundary: No PRE geometry target, validity, or loss authority is granted.
No POST geometry target, validity, or loss authority is granted.
No warhead-type target or reusable label is granted.
No reusable warhead rule is created.
No chemistry-state ground truth is granted.
No precursor ground truth is granted.
No reaction-mechanism ground truth is granted.
No model forward, loss, or training execution is granted.
No backward, optimizer, or parameter update is granted.
No model-weight or checkpoint save is granted.

subsequent_execution_conditions.statement: This candidate must be externally reviewed and published before it can become effective.
An active consumer requires a feature-semantics and intended-use audit.
Consumer wiring, tensor loss masks, and runtime activation require separate authority.
Step12D proves smoke legality only, not a final training-feature contract.
